words.zh: n. 包裹；一片地，一块地；  v. 打包，裹好
words.example: She received a small parcel from her friend in Australia.

words.zh: n. 果酱；阻塞；  v. （使）阻塞，使塞满
words.example: The heavy rain caused a serious traffic jam on the bridge.

words.zh: v. 邮寄；发电邮给；  n. 邮件，信件；邮政
words.example: The mail from the mainland arrives only once a week.

words.zh: adj. 第二的；次要的；(疾病、感染等) 继发性的；中学的；从属的，辅助的；中等教育的；【财】次要的，次级的；次级的；  n. 副手；代理人
words.example: In this course, grammar is secondary to practical communication skills.

words.zh: n. （制砖瓦、陶瓷制品的）黏土；泥土；肉体；  vt. 用黏土处理
words.example: The villagers use local clay to make pots and bricks.

words.zh: n. 尘土，沙土；灰尘，尘埃；粉尘，粉末；  v. 撒上粉末；掸掉，擦去，擦灰；使成粉末
words.example: A thick layer of dust covered the old books in the attic.

words.zh: adj. 落满灰尘的；土灰色的，灰暗的
words.example: The dusty road leading to the village was hard to walk.

words.zh: n. 杂草，野草；水草；海藻；大麻，大麻制品；  v. 除杂草
words.example: We need to weed the garden before planting new vegetables.

words.zh: n. 副歌部分；合唱团；合唱曲；齐声；  v. 合唱；齐声说
words.example: The whole class sang the chorus of the song together.

words.zh: phr. 齐声，异口同声
words.example: We heard a chorus of cheers from the crowd.

words.zh: n. 棉花；棉线；棉布；棉织品；  v. 理解；亲近
words.example: Farmers grow cotton in the warm climate of the south.

words.zh: v. 穿制服，使统一；  n. 制服，军服；校服；  adj. 相同的，统一的；一致的；【化】均匀的
words.example: All students in our school wear a blue and white uniform.

words.zh: phr. 不必提及，更不必说；且不说
words.example: The trip was long, not to mention the terrible weather we had.

words.zh: n. 药片；便笺簿；平板电脑；碑，匾；小块；写字板
words.example: The doctor told me to take one tablet after each meal.

words.zh: n. 橡皮；橡胶；橡胶制品，胶鞋；黑板擦
words.example: Use a rubber to erase the pencil marks on your test paper.

words.zh: n. 盥洗室，厕所
words.example: Excuse me, could you tell me where the washroom is?

words.zh: adj. 坚硬的；僵硬的；死板的；固执的；严格的
words.example: The teacher’s rigid rules left no room for creative thinking.

words.zh: v. 沸腾；  vi. 充满生气，情绪高涨；兴奋，欢闹；吐泡泡；  n. 气泡，泡沫；肥皂泡；泡影；幻想，妄想；靠不住的计划；泡；【化】气泡
words.example: When water boils, you can see bubbles rising to the surface.

words.zh: n. 隧道；管子，管道；地铁；电视；【化】管子，试管
words.example: The tube connects the pump to the water tank.

words.zh: n. 马戏团；杂技团；环形广场；闹剧（表示不满）；马戏
words.example: The children were excited to see the circus perform in town.

words.zh: n. 化学家；药剂师；药房；【化】化学家
words.example: The chemist explained how the medicine should be taken.

words.zh: n. 树荫，阴凉处；遮光物；阴影；鬼魂；灯罩；色度；百叶窗；（画的）阴影部分；一点，略微；  v. 遮蔽（光线）；画阴影，把……涂暗；险胜；加灯罩
words.example: We sat under a large tree to enjoy the shade on a hot day.

words.zh: n. 颌，颚，下巴；口部，嘴；口部；  v. 唠唠叨叨，喋喋不休
words.example: The boxer hit his opponent on the jaw and won the match.

words.zh: n. 皱纹；窍门；转折，改变；褶皱；  v. （使脸上）起褶皱，皱起
words.example: She noticed a deep wrinkle on her forehead in the mirror.

words.zh: n. 前额，前部
words.example: He wiped the sweat from his forehead after the long run.

words.zh: n. 小屋；简陋的小房子（或棚、舍）
words.example: The old fisherman lives in a simple hut by the sea.

words.zh: n. 住宅，房屋；住房供给；掩护；外罩
words.example: The government is building new housing for the growing population.

words.zh: n. 站台；平台，阵地；讲台；舞台；论坛；高台；【计】平台；游戏平台
words.example: The train for London leaves from platform nine.

words.zh: n. 壁炉
words.example: They sat by the fireplace and told stories during the cold night.

words.zh: n. 茶碟，茶托；浅碟形物
words.example: She placed her cup on the saucer and added sugar.

words.zh: n. 壶，水壶；锅；坑，穴
words.example: I put the kettle on the stove to boil water for tea.

words.zh: n. 平底锅；烤盘；  v. 严厉批评；淘金
words.example: She fried an egg in a non-stick pan for breakfast.

words.zh: n. 罐子，瓶子，坛子，缸；一罐，一瓶（的量）；  v. 震动；使烦躁；与……不和谐，相冲突
words.example: The cookies are kept in a large glass jar on the shelf.

words.zh: adj. 熟的，成熟的；时机成熟的；  v. 〈诗〉同“ripen“
words.example: These bananas are not ripe yet; wait two more days.

words.zh: v.  烧烤；  n. 烤架；烤肉餐馆
words.example: Dad will grill some fish and vegetables for dinner tonight.

words.zh: n. 门口；出入口；门道
words.example: A tall stranger appeared in the doorway of our classroom.

words.zh: n. 残余物；剩余物；剩菜；  adj. 残余的；吃剩的
words.example: We ate the leftover pizza for lunch the next day.

words.zh: n. 握手；【财】握手（同意）
words.example: A firm handshake can leave a good impression during a job interview.

words.zh: v. 拖，拉，拽，扯；（时间或事件）拖沓；拖着（身体）缓慢地行进；  n. 拖；拖累物；空气阻力；令人厌烦的人或事；  adj. 女穿男服的；男穿女服的；  adv. 带有女伴
words.example: She had to drag the heavy suitcase up the stairs to her room.

words.zh: n. 特权，优待；荣幸；  v. 给……特权
words.example: It is a great privilege to meet the famous scientist in person.

words.zh: vt. 插入（插头），接通（电源）；把......塞住，堵塞；宣传；补足；封堵；  n. 插头；塞子；插座；堵塞物
words.example: Remember to plug the charger into the socket before using the phone.

words.zh: adj. 伤残的；有残疾的；丧失能力的
words.example: The new library has special equipment for disabled students to use.

words.zh: v. 辞职，放弃；屈从，安于
words.example: After years of pressure, the coach decided to resign from his position.

words.zh: vt. 值得，应得；应受
words.example: You have worked hard all term, so you deserve a good rest.

words.zh: adv. 最近，不久前，近来
words.example: Lately, I have been reading a lot of science fiction novels.

words.zh: v. 【数】输入；  vt. 输入；  n. 投入；信息；【计算机】输入；【计】输入；情况
words.example: Please input your password to log in to the school website.

words.zh: v. 给……调音；调整，校准；调频道；【航】调谐；  n. 调音；曲调，旋律，曲子；协调
words.example: The guitarist spent an hour trying to tune his guitar before the concert.

words.zh: v. 感染（疾病）；签合同；订立（婚约）；缩减；招致（读作/kənˈtrækt/）；收缩；  n. 合同，契约（读作/ˈkɑːntrækt/）；【法】合同，契约
words.example: He contracted a serious illness while volunteering abroad.

words.zh: v. 允许，同意，准允；（勉强）承认；授予，给予；  n. 拨款；补助金
words.example: The university granted her a scholarship to support her research project.

words.zh: phr. 认为……是理所当然；认为理当如此；对……不予重视
words.example: We often take clean water for granted until it is scarce.

words.zh: adj. 心脏的，心脏病的；  n. 心脏病患者；强心剂；健胃剂
words.example: The patient suffered a sudden cardiac arrest and needed immediate treatment.

words.zh: n. 电路，线路；巡游；环行；巡回；环行路线；【化】电路，回路；【物】电路；【电】电路
words.example: The electrician checked the circuit to find why the lights were not working.

words.zh: n. 伤残，残障，障碍；（身体或智力的）缺陷
words.example: Her disability does not stop her from achieving great things in sports.

words.zh: n. 咨询；咨询会；商讨；协议会；就诊
words.example: The doctor scheduled a consultation with the patient's parents for tomorrow.

words.zh: v. 转播，转发（读作/rɪˈleɪ/）；传递（读作/rɪˈleɪ/）；  n. 替班；转播；接力赛跑（读作/ˈriˌleɪ/）；接班的人；【物】继电器
words.example: The volunteers helped relay important messages between the two teams.

words.zh: phr. 传达给；转发给
words.example: Please relay to the team that the meeting has been postponed.

words.zh: n. 标准，准则；原则
words.example: One important criterion for selecting the winner is originality of the design.

words.zh: n. 稳定，稳定性；稳固性；坚定，恒心；【财】稳定性；【电】稳定性
words.example: The new bridge was designed to provide stability during strong earthquakes.

words.zh: v. 祈祷，祈求，企盼；请求，恳求
words.example: Many people pray for peace in regions affected by conflict.

words.zh: adj. 假设的，假定的
words.example: The teacher asked us to consider a hypothetical situation where money did not matter.
